New Campaign

Set up an advertiser-funded program, then add flights to deliver it.

1

Campaign Details

Which partner is funding this program, and what it is called internally.

Shown in the campaign table and on every flight that belongs to it.
2

Reward Objective

How the reward logic behaves. This sets the default for flights created under it.

Customer-facing wording shown on the offer card. Flights can override it.
3

Schedule & Budget

Flights must sit inside this window and draw down from this budget.

Auto-pause on budget exhaustion Pause every flight in this campaign when the budget is fully consumed.
4

Targeting Defaults

Inherited by new flights. Any flight can override its own targeting.

Debit Prepaid Demand Deposit
One flight per customer Stops a customer being mapped to two flights in this campaign at once.
5

Approval Routing

Who has to sign off before any flight in this campaign can go live.
